get.description: Firebase identity and MFA required. Only customers with an existing transactions:read staff grant are included; no new permission or global scope is granted. Hong Kong natural days include today and end at request time using [from,to). Only succeeded transaction amounts contribute to flow; posted is a compatibility count for succeeded, not Slash settlement evidence. Pending/failed counts remain separate. Missing days have null amounts. Source completeness, customer/card/merchant metadata and channel sync are unavailable. USD and USDT are never combined. Unknown or repeated query parameters are rejected. Authorization, aggregates and audit share a repeatable-read transaction; audit failure returns no data.

Read customer registration metadata (active admin with MFA)
get.description: All active administrators with verified MFA may read customer login email, registration status and customer-link existence. Business customer names/IDs/actions are returned only under existing staff_grants. No customer/grant creation or financial writes. Default list is registered PostgreSQL customer-role users, sorted created_at/id descending; exact email lookup can additionally identify Firebase-only registrations. Firebase failure returns 503, never an empty result. Successful reads, including empty results, require a committed user_directory_audit row. Additional/duplicate query keys are rejected. No credentials or provider payloads returned.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Exact primary login email. Includes identity-only users that have not completed Moventra registration. Not a substring search. offset must be zero.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Exact registered customer user UUID for the details page. Mutually exclusive with email; offset must be zero. Missing users return an audited empty list. Existing users:list audit and resource-scoped customer links apply.

503.description: Database, identity lookup or audit unavailable

firebaseBearer.description: Verified email, valid Firebase identity and active locally provisioned user required. Admin reads additionally require MFA and explicit DB grants.
